statBlock.name: Vampire Nightbringer
statBlock.classification: Small or Medium undead, neutral evil
statBlock.description: A vampire born from necromancy or a plane steeped in negative energy. It stalks through shadows and drains life with its bite.

sections.Traits: Sunlight Hypersensitivity. At the start of its turn in sunlight, the vampire takes 10 Radiant damage. Sunlight also gives it Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Shadow Strike.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage and 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Reduce the target’s HP maximum by the Necrotic damage it actually took and restore that many HP to the vampire.
Shadow Strike. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage and 14 (4d6) Cold damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.

statBlock.name: Vampire Umbral Lord
statBlock.classification: Small or Medium undead, lawful evil
statBlock.description: A vampire that barters with powers of darkness for forbidden magic. Choose a concealed resting place when you prepare its lair.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a save, the vampire can spend one use to succeed.
Shadow Escape. If the vampire reaches 0 HP away from its resting place, it teleports there. If it can’t teleport, it is destroyed. It can’t teleport this way in sunlight or running water. After teleporting, it is Paralyzed for 1 hour, then recovers 1 HP.
Vampire Weakness. It needs an occupant’s invitation to enter a residence. It takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water. If someone drives a weapon that deals Piercing damage into its heart while it is Incapacitated in its resting place, it remains Paralyzed until the weapon comes out. At the start of its turn in sunlight, it takes 20 Radiant damage. Sunlight gives it Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using any combination of Grave Strike and Sickening Ray.
Grave Strike. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) Slashing damage and 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.
Sickening Ray. Ranged attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) Necrotic damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the start of the vampire’s next turn.
Hunger of Hadar (Recharge 5–6). Cast Hunger of Hadar at level 5 without components, using Charisma with spell save DC 18.
sections.Bonus actions: Sanguine Drain. Choose a creature the vampire can see within 30 ft. that is neither a Construct nor an Undead. On a failed DC 18 Constitution save, it takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. Reduce its HP maximum by the damage it actually took and restore that many HP to the vampire.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, or 4 in its lair. Spend one immediately after another creature’s turn to select one option. The vampire recovers spent uses at the start of its turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Beguile. Cast Command without components, using Charisma with spell save DC 18. Beguile then becomes unavailable until the vampire’s next turn starts.
Umbral Strike. Move up to half its Speed and make one Grave Strike or Sickening Ray attack.
sections.In its lair: 15,000 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 4/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Children of the Night. From dusk to dawn, Beasts of Medium size or smaller are Charmed while within 1 mile of the lair.
Looming Shadows. Shadows appear to move on their own. A creature that finishes a Short Rest within 1 mile must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save to benefit from that rest. The vampire and its allies are exempt.
Mists. Persistent fog makes the area within 1 mile Lightly Obscured. The vampire and creatures it chooses ignore the fog.
All three effects end as soon as the vampire dies or moves its lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 316 and 318. The stat block is on p. 318 and the regional effects are on p. 316.

statBlock.name: Graveyard Revenant
statBlock.description: A vengeful spirit pulls many corpses together into one body. It may hunt the people or institutions responsible for their deaths.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Traits: Undead Restoration. Unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains, the revenant revives after 24 hours. It animates a different group of corpses elsewhere on the same plane, changes appearance, and returns at full HP with this stat block.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Suffocate attacks.
Suffocate. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage and 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is also Grappled (escape DC 15) and suffocates until that grapple ends. The revenant can grapple up to two targets with this attack at once.
Haunting Glare (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. Emanation from the revenant makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure, the creature is Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

statBlock.name: Haunting Revenant
statBlock.description: A spirit possesses a ruin, wreck, or other abandoned place linked to its death. It waits for enemies to come close, then traps them inside.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Haunted Zone. A creature casting a spell inside the revenant’s space must pass a DC 17 Constitution save. On failure, the spell fails and is wasted.
Undead Restoration. Unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains, the revenant revives after 24 hours. It animates a different Gargantuan object or structure elsewhere on the same plane, changes appearance, and returns at full HP with this stat block.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Object Slam attacks and use Invitation.
Object Slam. Melee or ranged attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/90 ft. Roll with Advantage against targets inside the revenant’s space. A hit deals 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.
Invitation. Every creature in a 60-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Charisma save. On failure, the creature teleports into the revenant’s space and is swallowed. Swallowed creatures have Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside the revenant. As long as the revenant has HP, a swallowed creature can escape its space only through magic that enables planar travel, such as Plane Shift.

statBlock.name: Death Knight Aspirant
statBlock.classification: Small or Medium undead, chaotic evil
statBlock.description: A follower who shared a death knight’s curse. The aspirant leads other Undead into battle and carries out the death knight’s orders.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The aspirant has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Marshal Undead. Chosen Undead other than the aspirant have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws while in a 60-ft. Emanation from the aspirant. This trait stops working while the aspirant is Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Dread Blade attacks.
Dread Blade. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage and 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.
Hellfire Orb (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point the aspirant can see within 120 ft. Each creature in a Sphere of 20-ft. radius centered there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 21 (6d6) Fire damage and 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage. Success halves both.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma with spell save DC 15.
At will. Phantom Steed.
1/day each. Destructive Wave (Necrotic) and Dispel Magic.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack hits the aspirant while it holds a weapon, it can add 4 to its AC against that attack, potentially turning it into a miss.

statBlock.name: Will-o’-Wisp
statBlock.description: A wandering spirit that looks like a lantern. It lures travelers into danger and feeds when they fall.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Necrotic, Piercing, Slashing.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Ephemeral. The wisp cannot wear or carry anything.
Illumination. It sheds Bright Light out to 20 ft. and Dim Light for another 20 ft.
Incorporeal Movement. Creatures and objects count as Difficult Terrain for the wisp as it moves through them. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) Force damage.
sections.Actions: Shock. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) Lightning damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Consume Life. One living creature the wisp can see within 5 ft. with 0 HP makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On failure, the creature dies and the wisp regains 10 (3d6) HP.
Vanish. The wisp and its light become Invisible while it maintains Concentration. The effect also ends immediately after the wisp makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.
sections.Ambush ideas: A 1d6 roll can pick the danger the wisp leads travelers toward. 1. A building on the verge of collapse. 2. Waiting ghouls or vampires. 3. Ruins that curse intruders. 4. A predator’s den, such as a bear’s or wyvern’s. 5. Brown mold or green slime. 6. Quicksand or a pool under thin ice.

statBlock.name: Troll Limb
statBlock.description: A severed troll limb that moves, attacks, and can grow into a new troll.

sections.Traits:
Regeneration. The limb regains 5 HP at the start of its turn. Acid or Fire damage stops this trait on its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and does not regenerate.
Troll Spawn. A severed limb senses its surroundings as a whole troll would. If it survives 24 hours, roll a d12. On a 12 it becomes a Troll. On any other result, it withers away.
sections.Actions: Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.
sections.Severed by a troll: A limb created by a Troll’s Loathsome Limbs trait appears in the troll’s space and takes its turn immediately after the troll.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, Forest, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark.
